title: The Shy Black Dog
topic: ประสบการณ์ส่วนตัว
lines: Last summer, I volunteered at an animal shelter outside Bangkok. I
expected to spend my days playing with puppies. Instead, my first job
was cleaning cages, and **it** smelled terrible. By lunchtime, I wanted
Everything changed on the third day. A shy black dog named Coal had
been at the shelter for two years. Nobody wanted to adopt **him** because
he was old and afraid of people. The staff asked me to sit near his cage
for an hour each day and read aloud. At first, Coal stayed in the corner.
After a week, he came closer. After two weeks, he let me touch **his** ear.
On my last day, a young couple visited. They saw Coal resting his head
on my knee and asked about him. **They** adopted him that afternoon. The
staff said **this** would not have happened if Coal had still been afraid.
I learned that the most important work is not always the most exciting.
